comment: A DisclosureAck (DESIGN-COMPUTE §2.8, CTRUST-M12-02) made from these inputs, all synthetic: the identity key from seed_hex, the ids and pin as given. body_hex is the deterministic protobuf, signed_bytes_sha256_hex the SHA-256 of §6.9's signed bytes for purpose disclosure-ack and type 0x1809, signature_hex the Ed25519 signature, statement the Signed as the compute block holds it, standard base64. SIDECAR_REGENERATE_DISCLOSURE_ACK_VECTOR=1 go test -run '^TestDisclosureAckStatementRoundTrip$' writes the outputs again from the inputs.
